cross_division_ui.intro: Work that starts in your division but must be done by another division is sent through this page. The request lands in the target division's inbox (Intake), and that division's admin decides whether to accept or decline. You don't get access to the target division's content, and vice versa.

cross_division_ui.no_targets: No division can receive requests yet. Only divisions that have turned on Intake appear here, and turning it on is that division's own decision, not something that can be switched on from this page. Contact the target division's admin and ask them to enable Inbox/Intake in their department settings.
